TENS 7000 Digital TENS Unit with Accessories

$45.99
The TENS 7000 is one of those medical devices that physical therapists actually recommend and use themselves. It sends mild electrical pulses through pads placed on sore muscles, which can help interrupt pain signals and release tension — it's been around for decades and has a solid track record. This model comes with multiple pad sizes and placement options so you can target specific spots like your lower back, neck, or shoulders. It's not a cure-all, but for muscle pain that keeps coming back, it's a drug-free option worth trying before reaching for painkillers. The digital display and timer controls make it easy to dial in the intensity that works for you.
